application process: First-year applicants may apply using Common Application or QuestBridge Application for eligible students. Transfer applicants may apply using Duke Transfer Application or the Coalition, powered by Scoir.
university_specific_essay_required: Personal essay: one-page essay with short-answer questions specific to Duke; optional personal essay
financial_aid_policy: 52% of Duke students receive some form of financial aid
accepted_application_platform: Common Application, QuestBridge Application, Duke Transfer Application, Coalition (powered by Scoir)
minimum_standardized_test_scores: SAT 1520-1570 (middle 50% range for admitted students who submitted scores)
